skills.name: contribution-culture
skills.one_line_purpose: Do maintainer toil in small changes, never feature development.
skills.description: Defines the scope and manners of factory work: toil reduction for under-maintained projects in small, reviewable changes, never feature development. Use before deciding how large a change should be or what a task's deliverable is.

skills.name: factory-operations
skills.one_line_purpose: Keep bounded factory work moving until it lands or is externally blocked.
skills.description: Defines repository-neutral continuation, capacity, ownership, and evidence rules for bounded factory work.

skills.name: hive-read-side
skills.one_line_purpose: Maintain Review's explicit optional Hive read-side integration.
skills.description: Documents the optional Hive projections available only when Review mode and HIVE_HUB are explicitly selected.

skills.name: image-build
skills.one_line_purpose: Build and pin the single Review appliance.
skills.description: Maintains the Review appliance, release pins, SBOM inputs, and publication workflows.

skills.name: launcher
skills.one_line_purpose: Maintain the generic Review appliance launch contract.
skills.description: Maintains the Review appliance launcher, scope handoff, and credential boundary.

skills.name: luna-factory
skills.one_line_purpose: Keep the Luna Factory protocol's mechanical decisions in tested extension code.
skills.description: Maintains the opt-in Luna Factory extension in image/extension/luna-factory/. Use when changing admission, evidence reconciliation, convergence, or repair lineage.

skills.name: pr-workflow
skills.one_line_purpose: Prepare reviewable branches and pull requests for this repository.
skills.description: Defines branch, commit, push, and pull-request practice for Review + Luna Factory changes.

skills.name: review-checks
skills.one_line_purpose: Maintain neutral Review agents and generic policy.
skills.description: Maintains Review's generic policy seam and read-only specialist agents.

skills.name: review-dashboard
skills.one_line_purpose: Maintain the GitHub Review workbench and mutation guards.
skills.description: Maintains Review queue behavior, evidence, bounded actions, and mutation safeguards.

skills.name: review-monitoring
skills.one_line_purpose: Observe Review and Factory without disturbing active work.
skills.description: Use when observing or diagnosing an attended Review appliance or Luna Factory run.

skills.name: skill-improvement
skills.one_line_purpose: Keep review documentation source-backed, current, and compact.
skills.description: Maintains repository documentation and skill contracts from current source evidence. Use for repo-wide documentation audits, stale guidance, skill routing, catalog changes, or durable agent learning.
